title: Niju Kokohi Arazu
body:
Syntax: perform niju kokohi arazu <carried item>

Description: Project a false copy of a carried item onto the ground; it cannot be taken or sold. Project a false copy of a carried item on the ground. It cannot be picked up, equipped, or sold. Usable with any chakra nature. Illusion lasts 20 pulses. Unlocks at level 35. Costs 28 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
